observations.behavior: Adds a new boolean parameter `set_repository_as_team_default` to the Zod schema and its corresponding tool implementation, while also updating the repository description to account for a team default cleanup repository.
observations.posthog_connection: This change extends the API and MCP tool for ending or shipping an experiment. It allows a user to opt-in to saving the repository as the team's default cleanup repository, which could help streamline cleanup workflows for future experiments lacking a repository. This requires project admin access and is gated by existing repository and cleanup PR flags.
